content: Good morning, Sunrise Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
Good morning. I’d like to ask for… an appointment with a doctor, please. Any doctor would work.
May I have your full name, please?
Ah, yes. My name is Carlos Ruiz.
Your appointment with Dr. Lopez is confirmed for Monday at ten thirty in the morning.
Oh, um, I’m actually not sure about that time. I’d need to check my calendar first, and I want to think it over before deciding.
No problem. Would you like me to look for other available slots?
Oh, no, thank you. I think I’ll just… need to think about it. I’ll call you back if I decide to book.
Alright, feel free to call anytime. Have a great day!
Thank you, have a good day too.
